source.text: A lumped body: C dT/dt = q' - h(t) A (T - T_b), integrated by RK4 through the film history as written (h linear between its points, the 0.05 s fall included). Heat capacity per metre 206.404 J/m/K, outer surface 29.8451 mm2/mm. The pin warms monotonically, so the largest peak is the value at 40 s: 642.0735 K from 600 K. The tolerance is 1 % of the rise, fixed before any run (first-order step error 0.4 % at most, the lumped approximation, the 0.05 s the solver applies the new film value late).
source.check: Second method: FEED's independent finite-volume solution of the full pin with the history (src/core/transientFv.ts, tests/transientFvBoundary.test.ts, exact lumped solutions) and the real solver through tests/seedOracleBoundaryHistory.test.ts; the history is written to OFFBEAT as timeDependentAxialProfileHTC and judged by FEED's own cross-check in docs/boundary-history.md.

coverage.domain: synthetic pin with a conductivity of 400 W/m/K and a heat capacity of 3 MJ/m3/K (Biot about 0.001), 300 W/m from a uniform 600 K start, coolant at 600 K, film coefficient 500 W/m2/K falling to 100 between 10 and 10.05 s
